source.title: Appointment of a New WCA Financial Committee Leader (May 2018)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Committee Leader. Chris Hardwick is stepping down as the Leader of the **WCA Financial Committee**, and thus as the **WCA Treasurer**.

Chris has done a great work as the Leader of the WFC and as the Treasurer of the WCA, and we thank him for all his hard work and dedication all this time, as well as wish him the best in all his future endeavors.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. 
The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Basic knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA.
- Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing.
- Proficiency in English.
- A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties.
- Team management capabilities.

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **May 8th, 2018, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org))
<!-- break -->
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WFC Leader and the Treasurer of the WCA.

The rights and duties of the WFC are copied from [WCA Motion 10.2017.3](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mTeKEXe0DzD8olEQF_sy37OKtFcAPhAc/edit) in an appendix below.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2017.0](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

*APPENDIX - RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF WCA FINANCIAL COMMITTEE*

1. The WCA Financial Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA with the following rights and duties:
        1. Creating an annual budget proposal for the WCA.
        2. Managing the finances and accounts of the WCA in accordance with the approved annual budget proposal.
        3. Paying invoices and taxes that are directed to the WCA, after procuration by the WCA Board of Directors.
        4. Reporting and advising on a quarterly basis to the WCA Board of Directors on the finances of the WCA.
        5. Reporting on a periodic basis to external organizations on the finances of the WCA, based on all applicable legal requirements.
        6. Appointing and supporting financial auditors based on all applicable legal requirements.
2. The Leader of the WCA Financial Committee is the Treasurer of the WCA.

translation.title: WCA 财务委员会新负责人招募（2018 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命一位新的委员会负责人。Chris Hardwick 即将卸任 **WCA 财务委员会**负责人，同时卸任 **WCA 财务主管**。

Chris 在担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管期间表现出色。感谢他一直以来的辛勤工作与投入，也祝愿他今后一切顺利。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作。
我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

- 对 WCA 内部组织架构及工作流程有基本了解。
- 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税经验。
- 熟练使用英语。
- 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
- 具备团队管理能力。

申请现已开放，请于 **2018 年 5 月 8 日 23:59 UTC 前**，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管后的工作设想。

WFC 的权利与职责摘自 [WCA 动议 10.2017.3](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mTeKEXe0DzD8olEQF_sy37OKtFcAPhAc/edit)，列于文末附录。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2017.0](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NDLzup8rbfw8En0S6vtChNti9IKopDBq/edit)第 4 节的规定投票选定人选，经高级代表及现任委员会／团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。

*附录——WCA 财务委员会的权利与职责*

1. WCA 财务委员会是 WCA 的咨询委员会，拥有以下权利与职责：
   1. 为 WCA 制定年度预算提案。
   2. 按照获批准的年度预算提案，管理 WCA 的财务与账目。
   3. 经 WCA 董事会授权后，支付 WCA 应付的账单及税款。
   4. 每季度向 WCA 董事会汇报财务情况，并提供建议。
   5. 按照所有适用的法律要求，定期向外部机构报告 WCA 的财务情况。
   6. 按照所有适用的法律要求，任命并协助财务审计人员。
2. WCA 财务委员会负责人兼任 WCA 财务主管。
